(module asl-syntax/js/expr
                                                                                                       
  :x [parse
      parseString
      parseExpr
      parseExprString
      parseExprToSExpr
      exprNodeKind]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)
      (asl-syntax/core/tree :a tr)
      (asl-syntax/core/print :a pr)
      (asl-syntax/js/lex :a lx)])

fn exprNodeKind node: tr/Node -> String
  node.kind    

fn isTriviaTok tok: tr/Token -> Bool
  (let [(k tok.kind    )]
    (or (= k "whitespace")
    (or (= k "newline")
        (= k "comment"))))

(schema ParseCtx
  (:f src String)
  (:f toks (List tr/Token))
  (:f pos Int64))

fn ctxToken ctx: ParseCtx -> (Option tr/Token)
  (listGet ctx.toks     ctx.pos    )

fn ctxAdvance ctx: ParseCtx -> ParseCtx
  (ParseCtx :src ctx.src     :toks ctx.toks     :pos (+ ctx.pos     1))

(schema ParseResult
  (:f ctx ParseCtx)
  (:f node tr/Node)
  (:f sexpr String))

fn parseExprToSExpr s: String -> String
  (let [(tree (parseExprString s))]
    "1"))
